last_assistant_message:
All 14 verifier scripts ran cleanly and produced valid JSON with computed fields — no crashes. Dry-run results reflect genuine repo state (all three workflows are currently idle/reset, so early steps correctly `retry`; podcast-prep steps 4-5 `pass` because real `Episode 11.md`/PDF files exist in `meetings/podcast-prep/`; partner-meeting-prep step-04 correctly `retry`s because it discovered the historical xAI run's self-reported `outputs/xAI - 2026-06-24.md` output file does not actually exist anywhere in the repo).

All three workflows' `state.yaml` files were already valid YAML (confirmed via `yaml.safe_load`) — no fixes needed.

## Files created

**`workflows/one-on-one-prep/verify/`**
- `step-01-identify-meeting.py` — confirms `meeting_details.person` was actually captured (date optional per workflow rules)
- `step-02-gather-communications.py` — checks `communication_data` has all required structural keys; empty lists are valid
- `step-03-gather-tasks.py` — checks `task_data` structure and independently recomputes overdue-delegation count from due dates (not from self-reported flags)
- `step-04-assemble-brief.py` — verifies all upstream data (steps 01-03) is still intact in `accumulated-context` before assembly
- `step-05-quality-check-and-save.py` — globs `meetings/` for the actual saved brief file by person slug, validates required section headers and counts talking points via regex (must be ≥5)

**`workflows/podcast-prep/verify/`**
- `step-01-identify-episode.py` — checks `episode` context has number/title/guest name
- `step-02-gather-data.py` — checks `gathered_data` structural keys present
- `step-03-build-prep-sheet.py` — finds the dated guest-slug prep sheet in `meetings/podcast-prep/`, validates required sections and word count (≥300)
- `step-04-build-pdf-sheet.py` — finds `Episode {N}.md`, counts questions via regex (must equal exactly 6: 5 + wrap-up), checks required HTML markers (banner/intro-script/remember)
- `step-05-generate-pdf.py` — finds `Episode {N}.pdf`, validates PDF magic bytes and minimum size (≥5KB)

**`workflows/partner-meeting-prep/verify/`**
- `step-01-identify-partner.py` — confirms `partner_details.company` captured
- `step-02-account-overlap.py` — checks all three account groups present, cross-validates self-reported `summary.total_accounts` against actual computed list lengths (catches self-report drift)
- `step-03-events-and-context.py` — checks `events_and_context` structural keys present
- `step-04-build-document.py` — checks `accumulated-context.output_file` first, falls back to globbing `outputs/`, `meetings/`, `accounts/`, repo root by partner slug; validates required sections and counts intentional `TBD - partner to fill` blanks; accepts a documented inline-delivery fallback as a valid pass state

## Key finding

The `step-04-build-document.py` dry run surfaced a real, pre-existing gap: the partner-meeting-prep workflow's last completed run (xAI, 2026-06-24) self-reported the output saved to `outputs/xAI - 2026-06-24.md`, but that file does not exist anywhere in the repo (confirmed via `find`) — only an episodic memory note references it. This is exactly the kind of self-report-vs-ground-truth mismatch these verifiers are meant to catch; the new verifier correctly flags it as `retry` rather than trusting the historical claim.

Also worth noting: the historical xAI `state.yaml` accumulated-context uses a flat shape (`partner`, `contact`, `previous_prep`, `output_file`) rather than the nested `partner_details`/`account_overlap`/`events_and_context` structure the step files themselves define — the verifiers correctly flag steps 01-03 against that older run since the documented structure isn't present, which is accurate given the workflow spec.
